response: Tests remain active based on the configured **Test Expiration Time** (start/end date and time) in Settings > General. If candidates assigned in October 2025 have not received new tests, check whether the test itself has an end date set, or whether the invitations sent at that time had an expiry date configured. You can modify the test expiration time in Settings > General, and set invite expiry when sending invites.
justification: Document 1 states that you can define a start and end time to control when a test remains active, and that by default the Test Expiration Time fields are empty. Document 2 states that by default the Expiry option for invitations is set to Never, and the invitation does not expire unless a custom expiry is set.

To add 50% extra time (time accommodation) and then reinvite the candidate:

1. **Add time accommodation (percentage-based):**
   - Go to the **Tests** tab, open the test, then go to the **Candidates** tab.
   - Select the candidate's checkbox.
   - Click **More > Add Time Accommodation**.
   - Enter **50** (percentage, in multiples of five).
   - Click **Save**. The updated duration (105 minutes + 50% = ~158 minutes) will appear in the new test invite email and on the test landing page.

2. **Reinvite the candidate:**
   - In the same **Candidates** tab, select the candidate's checkbox.
   - Click **Invite selected**.
   - In the **Send Test Invites** section, click **Send invite**.
   - A confirmation appears noting the candidate has already attempted; click **Re-invite**.
   - Click **Send invite** to complete the reinvitation.

The reinvitation email will reflect the accommodated duration because time accommodation updates the invite email (Document 1).
justification: Document 1 describes adding time accommodation via percentage (steps 5-8) and notes the updated duration appears in the test invite email. Document 4 provides the reinvitation procedure (steps 5-9).
